svg.text: shallow tea-green water, reed beds, mangrove roots, flat mud banks
A. At fight distance, noon: the ground profile, the cover silhouettes, the far land as a value ladder. The two grey figures are 75 units tall (a fighter): scale only, no character art.
Palette at noon (the world-light tint per sky key multiplies it; lit, mid and shade are the three faces of one surface; the far ladder is each ridge hazed toward the horizon)

Readability (docs/art/dynamic-sky.md section 6): worst aura against any tone 22.8 CIEDE2000 (rule: 20 or more), worst Protagonist or rival body against ground, rock or vegetation 24.8 (rule: 15 or more), over every sky key with the world-light tint.
B. What the fight leaves: scorched (a beam along the ground), cratered (an impact), burned (fire on what grows)
a dark band along the water surface and reeds: reeds burnt to black stubs
for the beam's width, the water showing a darker film for a few seconds
a bowl that fills at once with tea-green water and a ring of churned mud;
a reed fire: tall straw reeds turned to black stubs over a patch, grey ash
floating on the water in flat flakes
C. Destruction in wetland: the impact at three moments (burst, peak, settle). Mud splash: dark brown globs on arcs, flung reeds, a ring of ripple; the water goes cloudy for a moment and settles.
D. Where it meets its neighbours (hard steps in colour, never a fade; the cover mixes over about a third of the width)
A river-mouth: the shallows go tea-green in steps, reed islands stand out in the
water, the shoreline is a mud bank.
Tidal flats: sand turns to grey-green mud in steps, pools with a pale rim, reeds
Pools open in the grass, reeds ring them, the grass grows darker and wetter.
A floodplain: flat, gold grass with pools and reeds, a few acacias on the higher
A swamp forest: trees stand in shallow water with arched roots; the floor is
A mangrove swamp: prop roots, dark water, hanging vines.
